items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Tony Fougerat, Mutt Powers, Fliver Ford, and J.B. Landry and myself were playing across the river in Plaquemine

ctx.x: Well back to Baton Rouge, we're gonna get to your wife. You said she was a dancer when the machine was off.
All right. Uh huh. Tony Fougerat, Mutt Powers, Fliver Ford, and J.B. Landry and myself were playing across the river in Plaquemine in a professional gambling place. And I mean big stakes too.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: That's the unit that left the Sanger Theater with my wife in it and the unit that I played for. You remember the boys from Baton Rouge that I told you? Fliver Ford. Mm-hmm. Tony Fougerat. Me and Mutt Powers. Mutt's dead. Tony's dead. Fliver's dead. And J.B. I don't know if he's still alive.
